question: What tap density did the NFA powders have?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%density%' ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%tap %' OR text ILIKE '%tap-%' OR text ILIKE '%tapped%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm%' OR text ILIKE '%g/cm%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm−3%' OR text ILIKE '%g cm^%' ORDER BY page

SELECT 'cell' AS k, id, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%density%' UNION ALL SELECT 'fact', id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%tap%' OR statement ILIKE '%density%' UNION ALL SELECT 'ocr', id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%tap%' OR text ILIKE '%density%' UNION ALL SELECT 'atom', id, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%tapping%' OR text ILIKE '%tap density%' OR text ILIKE '%packing%' OR text ILIKE '%bulk density%'

runs.text: The document does not report a tap density for the NFA powders. Searches of the text lines, table cells, figure facts and figure OCR found no mention of tap density, tapped density or bulk/packing density. The nearest related content is the powder sample preparation for diffraction and XPS (for example, the powder samples used for neutron diffraction), which does not give a density value.
